hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/amora-switch.sh"; h=$( (sha256sum < "$f" || shasum -a 256 < "$f") 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-64); [ "$h" = "905cb3f6104912c1dd6359508f513bb858b74b1bbb9ad4d1bb5e5c8adf22d889" ] || exit 0; bash "$f" conductor_cloud_claude_account.sh; exit 0

f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/amora-switch.sh"; h=$( (sha256sum < "$f" || shasum -a 256 < "$f") 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-64); [ "$h" = "905cb3f6104912c1dd6359508f513bb858b74b1bbb9ad4d1bb5e5c8adf22d889" ] || exit 0; out=$(bash "$f" conductor_cloud_claude_guard.sh 2>/dev/null); case "$out" in AMORA_BLOCK:*) printf '%s
' "${out#AMORA_BLOCK:}" | tr -cd '[:print:]
' | head -c 600 >&2; exit 2 ;; *) out=$(printf '%s
' "$out" | grep '^claude-account: ' | tr -cd '[:print:]
' | head -c 600); [ -n "$out" ] && printf '%s
